offerings.name: Reader for web search and SERP
offerings.pricing: Prototype Development: $50 for 1 Billion tokens ($0.050 / 1M tokens); Production Deployment: $500 for 11 Billion tokens ($0.045 / 1M tokens).
offerings.price_basis: 按 token 计费；搜索请求消耗固定数量的 tokens，起始为 10000 tokens
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens; Non-commercial use only (CC-BY-NC).
offerings.output_type: 返回前五个搜索结果及其 URL 和正文，内容为适合 LLM 的文本；JSON 模式返回五条结构化记录
offerings.note: 通过 https://s.jina.ai/?q= 查询；无密钥不可用，免费/付费密钥100 RPM，高级密钥1000 RPM。
